recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, conceptual portrait featuring a pale-skinned figure from the neck to the mid-torso against a solid, vibrant yellow-orange background. The figure's chest is wrapped in clear plastic film, securing several prescription pill bottles of varying sizes and colors (amber and white). The figure's hand, with matching orange-painted nails, rests delicately on their collarbone. The lighting is flat and clinical, casting a soft shadow against the backdrop.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic harmony between the background and the orange pill bottles
Contrast between the organic texture of skin and the synthetic texture of plastic wrap
Symmetry in the arrangement of medical containers across the torso
Juxtaposition of vulnerability (bare skin) with clinical coldness (medication)
coreInvariants: Clear plastic wrap binding objects to the body
Multiple prescription-style bottles with white caps
Matching nail polish color to the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered mid-shot, cropped from the lower lip to the waist, filling the frame vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The row of pill bottles wrapped in plastic across the center of the chest.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the lips, moves down the neck to the hand on the collarbone, and rests on the horizontal band of medical bottles.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Uniform solid background surrounding the figure's shoulders and head.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Clinical white (bottle caps and labels) and amber (bottle bodies)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background against low-saturation, high-value skin tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single utilitarian font family to maintain a clinical, regulatory aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the bold, condensed, utilitarian look of advisory labels.
Provides a clean, institutional feel appropriate for medical themes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A medium shot of a pale person from the neck to the waist against a solid bright orange wall. Their chest is tightly wrapped in several layers of clear plastic cling film. Tucked under the plastic wrap are five different prescription pill bottles (amber and white) arranged in a horizontal row. The person's hand with orange nails is resting on their chest.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a small, centered white rectangular block at the bottom containing three lines of bold, condensed sans-serif text in all caps.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, vibrant orange?
Are the pill bottles clearly visible under the plastic wrap?
Is the nail polish color an exact match for the background?
Is the text block centered at the bottom margin?

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the plastic texture

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the plastic wrap has realistic highlights and reflections.
Check that the skin tone appears natural but pale.
Verify the text is legible and follows the condensed block style.
Confirm the composition is strictly centered.
recipe.reuseFormula: Conceptual portrait + [Solid Color Background] + [Synthetic Material Wrap] + [Thematic Objects] + [Matching Accessory Color]
